0022600021.text: Dallas (3-2, 4th in the Southwest and 7th in the West, with two straight wins) hosts Houston (5-0, first in the Southwest and the West, on a five-game winning streak) in a regular-season Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game and the Mavericks' sixth of the season. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation), while Houston is missing Marcus Smart (forearm, strain), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf, strain), and Alperen Sengun is day-to-day with back soreness and is a game-time decision. Houston won the last meeting 128-110 in Houston on October 21, leaving the Mavericks trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 2-2 split in 2025-26.
